subject: Request: additional eval credits + short extension for Q4 RFP
messages:
From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@brighthealth.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@brighthealth.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question on eval credits for our RFP

Hi Kimberly,

We’re running the scale/latency portion of the BrightHealth evaluation this week and hit a ceiling on the sandbox allocation. The RFP evaluation window is tight — the procurement committee has asked for an extra 2 weeks and a larger token allowance so we can simulate peak-hour load (including streaming and long-context chains).

Can Redwood provide a short-term top-up or an extension to our trial credits for this bake-off? For context, a competitor has offered transient access to a dedicated node for a weekend test; we’re trying to keep things comparable.

Attached is the RFP appendix and a high-level security worksheet the team mentioned.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reed
Director, Data Platforms
BrightHealth Analytics

Attachments: BrightHealth_RFP_Appendix.pdf (application/pdf), security_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@brighthealth.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on eval credits for our RFP

Hi Tom — thanks for the context and the attachments.

We can absolutely support a modest, conditional top-up for a competitive bake-off. A few quick clarifying items so I can scope the approval with ops:
- Goal: are you aiming to replicate 48-hour peak load or spread testing over the 2-week window?
- Minimum required extra tokens and peak QPS target (ballpark is fine).
- Any non-standard security needs (VPC peering/isolated instance) beyond what’s in the worksheet?

My proposed path: we provision a provisional 30k token buffer and extend the evaluation window by 14 days, contingent on: 1) results shared in the evaluation doc, 2) a short mutual action plan, and 3) procurement sign-off on minimal T&Cs (no long-term commitment). I’ve looped Marcus and Rishi to confirm operational budget and whether we should attach a pilot discount for committed spend post-bake-off.

If that works, I’ll ask sales ops to create a temporary offer and a DocuSign for procurement.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on eval credits for our RFP

Kimberly — fine to approve a conditional top-up. Please follow the gating below so we don’t set a precedent:
- Approve provisional 30,000 token credit and +14 day window.
- Require a one-page mutual action plan (owner, success criteria, timeline).
- Offer a 10% pilot discount on paid usage if BrightHealth converts within 60 days after the bake-off.
- Sales ops to create a temporary promo code and a DocuSign amendment that procurement signs for internal audit.

Rishi — can you confirm we have runway in the Q4 promo pool for this? Also add a quick note in the HubSpot deal timeline so finance can reconcile.

-Marcus
VP, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@brighthealth.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@brighthealth.ai>
Date: 2026-10-13T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on eval credits for our RFP

Kimberly / Marcus — that plan should work. A couple of asks from procurement before we sign a DocuSign:
1) Can you confirm whether the top-up will be isolated to our org (no shared caching) for the evaluation window?
2) We’d like a 2-week extension after the original window to allow our clinical partners to run late-stage tests.
3) BrightHealth can accept a short pilot discount but asks that any post-bake-off credits be invoiced separately (procurement prefers an upfront PO path).

If you can confirm (1) isolation and (2) extension, procurement will sign the amendment this afternoon.

Appreciate the flexibility — this helps us make an apples-to-apples comparison.

—Tom

On 2026-10-12 15:05, Marcus Lin wrote:

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@brighthealth.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Legal <legal@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on eval credits for our RFP

Tom — confirming:
- Isolation: yes. The top-up will be provisioned on an isolated evaluation namespace with KV/prefix caching disabled to avoid cross-tenant leakage. I’ve asked infra to enable a dedicated sandbox instance for the 14-day window.
- Extension: approved (+14 days). We’ll reflect the new dates in the DocuSign amendment.
- Procurement invoicing: we will accept a PO for any paid conversion; the free top-up is provided as a one-time promotional grant and will be logged against DEAL-8472.

Rishi — can you generate the temporary promo code and create the HubSpot note? Legal, I’ve cc'd a brief so we can get a signature. I’ll upload the amendment link when ready.

Thanks — I’ll circle back with the DocuSign and the sandbox details (endpoint, credentials) this morning.

-Kimberly
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
